scripts.build: sh -ec 'echo "Selecting latest artifact by directory timestamp..."; DIR=$(find iflows -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -printf "%T@ %p\n" | sort -n | tail -1 | cut -d" " -f2-); test -n "$DIR"; FILE=$(find "$DIR" -name "*.zip" | head -1); test -n "$FILE"; test -f "$FILE"; BASENAME=$(basename "$FILE"); echo "Selected directory: $DIR"; echo "Processing $FILE"; unzip -t "$FILE"; mkdir -p dist; cp "$FILE" "dist/$BASENAME"; NEXUS_USER="admin"; test -n "$nexus_password"; test -n "$ARTIFACT_URL"; echo "Uploading to Nexus..."; curl --fail --show-error --silent -u "$NEXUS_USER:$nexus_password" -T "dist/$BASENAME" "$ARTIFACT_URL/$BASENAME"; echo "Uploaded successfully"'
scripts.deploy: echo "⬇ Downloading from Nexus..." && curl -v -u "$NEXUS_USER:$NEXUS_PASSWORD" -O "$ARTIFACT_URL/$ARTIFACT_NAME" && echo "🚀 Deploying to CPI..." && curl -v -X POST "$CPI_URL/IntegrationDesigntimeArtifacts(Id='$IFLOW_NAME',Version='active')/$value" -u "$CPI_USER:$CPI_PASSWORD" -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" --data-binary @$ARTIFACT_NAME && echo "▶ Starting iFlow..." && curl -v -X POST "$CPI_URL/IntegrationRuntimeArtifacts('$IFLOW_NAME')/Start" -u "$CPI_USER:$CPI_PASSWORD"
